meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为 HyperFrames 合成设计视觉动效：推近推出、缩放、平移、遮罩、路径、SVG 形变、文字移动等，并保证动画在时间轴上可精确定位（seek-safe），同时提供检查命令。
howto.when: 当你说要为 HyperFrames 合成做推近推出、缩放、平移等视觉动效，或涉及 GSAP、CSS keyframes 等时触发；不做剪辑、字幕或整体规划。

say.text: 给这个 HyperFrames 合成做一个推近到主体的效果
say.note: 会生成可定位的关键帧并验证

say.text: 用 GSAP 让这个元素从左滑入
say.note: 会按 GSAP 规则创建暂停时间线

say.text: 检查一下这个合成的关键帧是否安全

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will design visual keyframe animations for HyperFrames compositions — push-ins, zooms, pans, masks, paths, SVG morphs, text motion, etc. — and keep them seek-safe, offering verification commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when HyperFrames needs keyframed visual motion such as push-in/out, zoom, pan, Ken Burns, or camera moves, or when using GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, etc. Not for scene strategy or planning.

say_en.text: Add a push-in to the subject for this HyperFrames composition.
Animate this element sliding in from the left using GSAP.
Check whether this composition's keyframes are seek-safe.
